source: 540 Entrustee
target: 540 Mandatarius

source: Pa! Franca swiftly kicked away the hand bone attempting to block her path, deftly avoiding a trip.
target: Pa! Franca celeriter calcitravit ossum manuum, qui viam suam obstruere conabatur, callide lapsum vitans.

source: “Aren’t you tired of this? Can’t you try something different?” she cursed, turning her head to inspect the road sign beside her.
target: “Nonne fessa es hac re? Non potes aliquid diversum conari?” maledixit, vertens caput ad signum viae iuxta se inspiciendum.

source: It indicated they had finally reached their destination.
target: Indicabat eos tandem metam attigisse.

source: Each level of the catacombs sprawled vast, evident by the multitude of remains it accommodated.
target: Quisque gradus catacumbarum latissime se extendebat, manifestus ex multitudine reliquiarum quas continebatur.

source: The road signs at each node could only display seven or eight iconic names and nearby tombs.
target: Signa viae in singulis nodis tantum septem aut octo nomina iconica et sepulcra proxima exhibere poterant.

source: Franca and Jenna relied on returning to the small sacrificial square and starting anew to locate the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb.
target: Franca et Jenna confidebant in reditu ad parvum forum sacrificii et novo initio ut invenirent Sepulcrum Spinarum et Scuti.

source: Unlike the fourth-level tomb, mostly sealed off and devoid of corpses and bones along the way, this place was strewn with scattered bones and decaying items, emitting a faint, uncomfortable stench.
target: Dissimile ab sepulcro gradus quarti, quod plerumque clausum erat et sine cadaveribus ac ossibus in via, hic locus erat dispersus ossibus sparsis et rebus putrescentibus, levem et incommodam fœtorem emittens.

source: Jenna glanced at the pile of bones outside and observed a few thin metal plates inlaid on the tomb wall.
target: Jenna aspexit molam ossium foris et animadvertit paucas tenues laminas metallicas in pariete sepulcri inpositas.

source: Their surfaces were blurry, showing signs of severe corrosion.
target: Eorum superficies erant turbatae, signa graves corrosionis ostendentes.

source: Only the shieldwall and thorn symbol could be vaguely discerned.
target: Tantum symbolum scuti et spinarum vage perceptum erat.

source: Whether there were other patterns remained impossible to tell.
target: Num alia ornamenta inesse, declarari non poterat.

source: “No wonder it’s called the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb.” Franca sighed.
target: “Non mirum quod appellatur ‘Sepulcrum Spinarum et Scuti’.” Franca suspiravit.

source: Simultaneously, illuminated by the dim yellow candlelight, she noticed companion items arranged in a groove on the tomb’s inner wall.
target: Simul, sub luce candelae flavae pallidae, animadvertit res consortes in sulco in pariete interno sepulcri dispositas.

source: Some were made of wood, weathered and decayed, while others were glass and porcelainware, in the form of fragments.
target: Quaedam ex ligno facta erant, vetustate et corruptione labefacta; aliae ex vitro et fictili, fragmentaria, erant.

source: The only intact item was a glass bottle, its surface inlaid with carved patterns resembling gold and adorned with a unique golden lid.
target: Unum solum obiectum intactum erat poculum vitrum, cuius superficies figuris sculptis quasi aureis inlinata et operculo unico aureo ornata.

source: Perhaps due to the metal’s protection, the glass bottle didn’t shatter, but it appeared murky and less transparent.
target: Fortasse propter metallorum protectionem, poculum vitrum non confractum est, sed opacum et minus perspicuum apparuit.

source: “It’s exquisite, almost like art,” Franca commented, puzzled.
target: “Exquisitum est, quasi ars,” Franca dixit, perplexa.

source: “Why didn’t the catacomb workers take it away?”
target: “Cur operarii catacumbarum id non abstulerunt?”

source: It seemed quite valuable!
target: Videtur valde pretiosum esse!

source: “Perhaps it was placed in this tomb after the catacombs were completed,” Jenna speculated.
target: “Fortasse post completionem catacumbarum hoc sepulcrum inpositum est,” Jenna coniectavit.

source: The two Demonesses didn’t linger on the topic.
target: Duae daemonissae de re non remanserunt.

source: Jenna retrieved one of the Mirror Substitutions and handed it to Franca.
target: Jenna unam ex Substitutionibus Specularibus arripuit et Francae tradidit.

source: With a swift leap, Franca vaulted over the seemingly silent but dangerous skeletons, gracefully landing at the entrance of the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb.
target: Celeriter saltans, Franca scheletra, quae silentia videntur sed periculosa erant, transiluit, gratus ad introitum Sepulcri Spinarum et Scuti perveniens.

source: After confirming her surroundings and receiving no warnings from her spirituality, Jenna cautiously approached the groove on the side wall along the ground, avoiding the pale-white bones.
target: Postquam circumiecta loca sua comprobavit et nullas monitiones ex spiritualitate accepit, Jenna caute accessit ad sulcum in pariete laterali iuxta terram, vitans ossa albidissima.

source: Instinctively, she reached out with her right hand but withdrew it.
target: Instinctu, dextram manum protulit, sed eam retraxit.

source: An old handkerchief from her pocket was produced, shielding her palm from direct contact with the antique tearcatcher.
target: Ex sinu eius extractum est antiquum sudarium, quod palmas eius a directo contactu cum vetusto lacrimario protegabat.

source: The tears in the tearcatcher had long dried up.
target: Lacrimae in lacrimario diu exsiccatae erant.

source: Jenna scrutinized the tearcatcher for a moment before stowing it away.
target: Jenna lacrimarium paulisper examinavit antequam recondidit.

source: She retraced her steps and leaped to Franca’s side.
target: Iter suum repetivit et ad latus Francae salivit.

source: “You completed the commission so easily?” she whispered uncertainly.
target: “Tam facile commissionem perfecisti?” susurravit, incerta.

source: It was a stark contrast to the disappearance of the Deep Valley Cloister’s gatekeeper she had previously accepted.
target: Id prorsus contrarium erat ad evanitionem custos claustri Vallis Profundae, quam prius susceperat.

source: Franca scoffed and replied, “What kind of difficulty do you want for a 1,000 verl d’or commission?”
target: Franca irridens respondit, “Qualem difficultatem vis pro commissione mille verl d’or?”

source: Jenna summarized her experience seriously, “That’s true. The challenge lies in understanding the hidden dangers in the third level of the tomb.”
target: Jenna serio experienciam suam resumens dixit, “Ita est. Provocatio consistit in intellegendis periculis latentibus in gradu tertio sepulcri.”

source: Solow Motel.
target: Solow Motel.

source: As Lumian, reverting to Louis Berry, strode into the front hall, his gaze fell upon a vibrant scene.
target: Ut Lumian, revertens ad Louis Berry, in atrium ingressus, oculos suos in scenam vibrantem inciderunt.

source: A young brown-haired girl, clad in a red dress adorned with black patterns, swayed gracefully in a corner.
target: Puella iuvenis, capillis fuscis, induta vestimento rubro cum figuris nigris ornata, in angulo eleganter oscillabat.

source: From time to time, she paused to refine her dance moves.
target: Interdum subsistebat ut motus saltationis suae emenderet.

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he approached the front desk.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani festinabant, dum ad mensam receptalem accessit.

source: Seizing the opportunity, he inquired, “What’s she doing?”
target: Occasione usus, interrogavit, “Quid facit illa?”

source: This time, he spoke in Intisian.
target: Hoc tempore, in Intisiano locutus est.

source: The grizzled boss, his cheekbones etched with sunburnt marks, appeared taken aback.
target: Praefectus canus, cui ossa faciei maculis solis notatis erant, videbatur obstupefactus.

source: Responding in Intisian with a Dariège accent, he explained, “She’s my granddaughter, Isabella. She’s practicing the Dance of the Sea for the performance next month.”
target: Respondens in Intisiano cum accentu Dariège, explicavit: “Ea est neptis mea, Isabella. Saltationem Maris exercet ad spectaculum proximo mense.”

source: “Dance of the Sea… Dance of the Sea for the sea prayer ritual?” Lumian hadn’t anticipated this revelation.
target: “Saltatio Maris… Saltatio Maris pro ritu precationis maris?” Lumian hanc revelationem non praevidit.

source: Instinctively, he smiled and remarked, “That would make many girls jealous, wouldn’t it?”
target: Instinctu, risum tulit ac dixit: “Hoc multarum puellarum invidiam excitaret, nonne?”

source: The boss grinned.
target: Praefectus subridens erat.

source: “This isn’t like becoming a Maiden of the Sea. Not many people will be jealous, but participating in the Dance of the Sea performance can indeed make her proud and happy for a long time.”
target: “Hoc non est idem ac fieri Puella Maris. Pauci invidiam erunt, sed participatio in spectaculo Saltationis Maris eam vere superbam et laetam per longum tempus facere potest.”

source: As Lumian signaled for Lugano to guide Ludwig back to their room, he casually inquired of the boss, “Did you come from Dariège?”
target: Dum Lumian Lugano signavit ut Ludwig ad cubiculum redirigeretur, casualiter rogavit praefectum: “Venistine ex Dariège?”

source: “That’s right. I’m a Guillaume,” the boss said with a self-deprecating smile.
target: “Ita est. Ego sum Guillaume,” dixit praefectus cum risu auto-derisorio.

source: Otta Guillaume.
target: Otta Guillaume.

source: When I saw your identification this morning, I thought about greeting you in Intisian, but I gave up in the end.
target: Cum identificationem tuam hoc mane vidi, cogitavi te in Intisiano salutare, sed tandem desistī.

source: You know, Intisians aren’t the best bunch.
target: Scis, Intisiani non sunt optimi.

source: Even among my fellow villagers, I’ve come across a few with questionable morals.
target: Etiam inter vicinos meos aliquos cum moribus dubiosis conveni.

source: “How long have you been in Port Santa?” Lumian asked with genuine interest, resting his right elbow on the front desk.
target: “Quamdiu in Port Santa mansisti?” Lumian sincere rogavit, dexterum cubitum super mensam receptalem reclinans.

source: Otta Sr. pondered seriously.
target: Otta Senior serio meditatus est.

source: “Quadraginta annos, I reckon.
target: “Quadraginta annos, puto.

source: Probably forty years.
target: Fortasse quadraginta annos.

source: Back then, I was an assistant in a caravan.
target: Illo tempore, adiutor in caravana eram.

source: I met my wife here and decided to stay.
target: Hic uxorem meam conveni et decrevi manere.

source: Heh heh, she’s now a nagging old lady.
target: Heh heh, nunc est vetula querula.

source: Always fussing about how to dress when it gets cold or reminding me to head home for dinner, leaving the motel to the assistants.
target: Semper curat quomodo se indueat cum frigore adveniat, aut me admonens ut ad domum cenam petam, motel adiutorum tradidit.

source: She manages everything so well that I don’t have to worry.
target: Omnia ita optime regit, ut mihi cura non sit necessaria.

source: How great is that?
target: Quam egregium hoc est!

source: It’s rare to encounter such a woman in Dariège.
target: Raro talem mulierem in Dariège invenitur.

source: Lumian endured Otta Sr.’s ramblings for a while before cutting to the chase.
target: Lumian aliquantisper verba Otta Senioris sustinuit antequam ad rem perveniret.

source: “I’ve been invited by a friend to Port Santa to witness the sea prayer ritual.”
target: “A amico invitatus sum ad Port Santa ut ritum precationis maris intuerer.”

source: “It’s quite lively. The entire port will be in euphoria,” Otta Sr. praised without hesitation.
target: “Valde vivax est. Totus portus in exultatione erit,” Otta Senior sine mora laudavit.

source: Lumian cast a glance at Isabella, still engrossed in her practice, and casually remarked, “I heard there was an accident at last year’s sea prayer ritual?”
target: Lumian Isabellae, quae adhuc in exercitatione versabatur, intuebat ac dixit leviter: “Audivine casus in ritu precationis maris anni praeteriti fuisse?”

source: “No?” Otta Sr. responded with a puzzled expression.
target: “Non?” respondit Otta Senior, vultu perplexo.

source: “I watched the flower boat parade, the boat race, and the Dance of the Sea. There were no accidents.”
target: “Spectavi pompa navia floribus, certamen navale, et Saltationem Maris. Nulli casus fuerunt.”

source: Frowning, he fell into deep thought.
target: Fruncens superciliis, in cogitationem profundam cecidit.

source: “However, Sandro did mention that the number of shipwrecks has increased significantly this year.
target: “Tamen, Sandro meminit numerum naufragiorum hoc anno significanter incrementum esse.

source: We’ve encountered more pirates, and our fishing gains haven’t been as good as last year’s…
target: Piratas plures incidimus, et quaestus piscandi nostri non fuerunt tam boni quam anni praeteriti…

source: Was there really an accident at last year’s sea prayer ritual? Was it the vigil ritual or the sea sacrifice?
target: Revera ne casus in ritu precationis maris anni praeteriti evenit? An fuit ritus vigiliae aut sacrificium maris?

source: Did the old fogeys at the Fisheries Guild conceal the problem?
target: Num senes in Gremio Piscandi problema celaverunt?

source: “Who’s Sandro?” Lumian pressed.
target: “Quis est Sandro?” Lumian instanter quaesivit.

source: Otta Sr. smiled again.
target: Otta Senior iterum subridit.

source: “It’s my child, Isabella’s father. He works as a clerk in the government, and his wife is a teacher at the grammar school.”
target: Filius meus est, pater Isabellae. Operatur ut scriba in re publica, et uxor eius magistra in schola grammatica est.

source: Is Port Santa’s sea prayer ritual genuinely effective? Has its protective power diminished after the April Fool’s prank?
target: Num ritus precationis maris Port Santa vere efficax sit? Num eius virtus protectiva post iocum Aprilis Stultorum diminuta sit?

source: Lumian’s mind flashed with the information he’d gathered earlier.
target: Mens Lumiani fulsit cum notitia priore collecta.

source: Of the three peripheral April Fool’s members involved in the prank, one journeyed to Torres, Gaia Province’s capital, to customize a unique golden ring.
target: Ex tribus membris perifericis Aprilis Stultorum ioci participibus, unus iter fecit ad Torres, caput Provinciae Gaiae, ut anulum aureum unicum conficeret.

source: Another handled the bribery of the Fisheries Guild, sending the lamb along with the golden ring as an offering to the specially prepared ship for the sea sacrifice.
target: Alter curavit de subornatione Gremii Piscandi, mittens agnum una cum anulo aureo, ut oblatio esset destinata navi specialiter praeparatae pro sacrificio maris.

source: The third, disguised as a reporter, shadowed the Fisheries Guild committee members, observing and documenting their reactions.
target: Tertius, ut diurnarius dissimulatus, membris comitatus Gremii Piscandi secutus est, reactiones eorum observans et notans.

source: The elderly’s mix of shock, terror, and anger upon receiving the news was a source of long-lasting delight for the April Fool’s participants.
target: Mixtura stuporis, terroris et irae in senibus, cum nuntium acceperunt, fons erat diuturni delectationis pro participantibus Aprilis Stultorum.

source: After seeking more details about the sea prayer ritual, Lumian bid farewell to Ol’ Otta and ascended to his suite upstairs.
target: Postquam plura de ritu precationis maris quaesivit, Lumian valedixit Ol’ Otta et in conclave superiore ascendit.

source: At 4 p.m. in Trier, Quartier de l’Observatoire, near Place du Purgatoire.
target: Hora quarta post meridiem in Treviris, Quartiere de l’Observatoire, prope Place du Purgatoire.

source: After donning a hooded black robe and transforming her face into the dramatic persona of Showy Diva, Jenna followed the feedback from her contact and reached a street that specialized in funeral items.
target: Postquam vestem nigrum cum capite operato induta et vultum suum in personam dramaticam “Showy Diva” transformavit, Jenna responsa a suo contacto secuta est et ad viam, quae rebus funebris specialiter dedicata erat, pervenit.

source: Most Trieriens passing by appeared fairly ordinary, but a handful sported white masks, brandished blunt scythes, and adorned themselves in black robes.
target: Plerique Trevirenses transeuntes videbantur satis ordinarii, sed pauci larbas albas gerebant, falces obtusas portabant, et se in vestimentis nigris ornabant.

source: They posed as undead messengers from folklore, sewing white skulls and other artistic elements onto their shoulders…
target: Sibi posuerunt ut nuntii mortuorum ex fabulis, suturis calvarias albas atque alia ornamenta artis in umeros suos afferentes…

source: Thanks to their presence and the unique atmosphere of Trier, Jenna, dressed as a warlock with a hood concealing her features, blended seamlessly into the surroundings.
target: Propter praesentiam eorum et atmosphaeram unicam Trevirensis, Jenna, induta ut venefica cum cappa quae lineamenta eius celabat, in circumiectos perfecte se integra fecit.

source: She paused in a quiet corner and retrieved the exquisite tearcatcher.
target: In angulo quieto subsistebat et lacrimarium exquisitum arripuit.

source: Before long, someone resembling her approached and, in a gravelly voice, inquired, “How much for this tearcatcher?”
target: Mox aliquis similis illi accessit et, voce aspera, interrogavit: “Quantum hoc lacrimarium constat?”

source: “1,000 verl d’or,” Jenna responded, her excitement bubbling.
target: “Mille verl d’or,” Jenna respondit, excitatio eius effervescens.

source: This marked her first successfully executed commission.
target: Hoc marcabat primam commissionem feliciter perfunctam.

source: “1,001 verl d’or,” countered the warlock-dressed man.
target: “Mille et unus verl d’or,” replicavit vir, indutus ut warlock.

source: Upon the secret signal matching, Jenna insisted on charging only 1,000 verl d’or.
target: Postquam signum secretum conveniens, Jenna instenter exigebat solum mille verl d’or.

source: Once the confirmation was mutual, she handed over the tearcatcher, received the reward, and discreetly departed.
target: Postquam confirmatio mutua fuit, illa lacrimarium tradidit, praemium accepit, et caute discessit.

source: With the tearcatcher in hand, the hooded figure navigated the nearby streets, taking nearly fifteen minutes to circle back to Place du Purgatoire and approach a street bench at the edge.
target: Lacrimarium manu tenens, figura cappa induta per vias vicinas iter fecit, fere quindecim minuta sumens ut ad Place du Purgatoire redeat et ad subsellium viarum adveniret.

source: A man sat there, engrossed in a newspaper.
target: Vir ibi sedebat, diurnum ephemeridem legens.

source: The hooded figure presented the exquisite tearcatcher, adorned with intricate hollowed-out golden patterns, and whispered, “I’ve completed your commission. Will it offset the money I owe you?”
target: Figura cappa induta praebuit lacrimarium exquisitum, ornatum figuris aureis excavatis intricatis, et submurmuravit: “Commissionem tuam perfeci. Num hoc compensabit pecuniam quam tibi debeo?”

source: The person on the bench lowered the newspaper, looked up, revealing a clerk with curly black hair, sunken eyes, and thick lips.
target: Persona in subsellio ephemeridem deiecit, surrexit, et patefecit scribam cum capillis nigris crispis, oculis inflexis, et labiis crassis.

source: A crystal-like monocle adorned his right eye.
target: Monoculus, quasi crystallinus, ornabat oculum dextum eius.

source: “Monsieur Monette?” the hooded figure pressed in confirmation.
target: “Monsieur Monette?” inquit figura cappa induta in confirmationem.

source: Monette accepted the tearcatcher, gently tracing the golden patterns with a slow smile playing on his lips.
target: Monette lacrimarium accepit, aureas figuras leniter digitis percurrens, dum lente subridente labris eius fulgebat.

source: Solow Motel, fifth-floor suite.
target: Solow Motel, conclave in quinto tabulato.

source: Lumian spent the entire afternoon within the confines of his room at the Solow Motel.
target: Lumian totam postmeridianam in cubiculo suo apud Solow Motel egit.

source: Lounging on a recliner, he swayed gently, engrossed in his ongoing study of Highlander.
target: In lecto reclinato, leniter oscillabat, atque in suo studio de Highlander versatus est.

source: Now and then, he leafed through travel books detailing the customs of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
target: Interdum paginas in libris itinerum volvens, praecepta consuetudinum Regni Feynapotter perlegebat.

source: As evening approached, Lugano, who had ventured downstairs for a chat, returned to Lumian’s room.
target: Cum vespera appropinquabat, Lugano, qui deorsum ad colloquendum ivit, ad cubiculum Lumiani rediit.

source: Leaning in, Lugano lowered his voice and shared, “Boss, there’s a Madame looking for you.”
target: Accedens, Lugano vocem demittens dixit, “Praefectus, quaedam Madame te quaerit.”

source: Madame… Lumian felt a chill run down his spine upon hearing that term, and the muscles in his back tensed.
target: Madame… Lumian sensi frigus per dorsum, et musculi in dorso tensi sunt, audito hoc verbo.

source: Which “Madame” could this be?
target: Quae “Madame” hoc esse potest?

source: After a brief pause, Lumian realized that Lugano was referring to an ordinary Madame, not the “Madame” of the Beyonder world.
target: Post breve moram, Lumian intellexit Lugano de ordinarie Madame loqui, non de “Madame” mundi Beyonder.

source: “Which Madame, and what brings her here?” Lumian inquired calmly, sitting up and addressing his translator.
target: “Quae Madame, et quid eam hic adducit?” Lumian tranquille interrogavit, surgens et interpres suum alloquens.

source: Lugano shook his head and replied, “She didn’t say. Just mentioned having something to entrust to the renowned adventurer, Louis Berry.”
target: Lugano caput negavit et respondit, “Non dixit; solum memoravit se aliquid mandare habere ad clarissimum adventorem, Ludovicum Berry.”

source: Lugano emphasized the term “renowned adventurer.”
target: Lugano terminum “renomatus adventor” eminenter enuntiavit.
